newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan provincial governor James Soong to reveal his future on current post today (Tuesday).
China agrees to monitor peace accords in Guatemala.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Bill Clinton reiterates commitment to peace, security in inaugural speech.
Communist China to push for cross-straits political negotiations in second half of 1997.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taipei-Pretoria talks on future bilateral relations yield no significant breakthrough.
President Lee Teng-hui says Taiwan should not be defined according to "traditional international law".
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Tainan science park to include 12-inch wafer plants.
Government forecasts no growth in Taiwan's exports to United States in 1997.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Mitac buys U.S. computer distributor Merisel.
Stock index climbs close to seven-year high.
